Package hu.bme.mit.theta.solver

Class UserPropagator

java.lang.Object
hu.bme.mit.theta.solver.UserPropagator
public abstract class UserPropagator extends Object
A theory plugin that the solver calls back during search. Subclasses override the callbacks they need and use the propagate methods to steer the search.

A propagator is attached to one solver by SolverFactory.createSolverWithPropagators(UserPropagator...), which binds it to that solver's UserPropagator.Backend. Only expressions passed to registerExpression(hu.bme.mit.theta.core.type.Expr<hu.bme.mit.theta.core.type.booltype.BoolType>) are reported to the callbacks, and only those may appear in a conflict or as the premises of a consequence.
